steps.content: No one is going anywhere until you pay for the repairs.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pay for the repairs? Hecate, isn't this just a hologram? Since when do holograms need repairs?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: "Please note that certain reparations will be required if excessive damage has been caused to the world."
Hecate produces a manual and points to the fine print at the very bottom for Hella to see.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh come on, that's so not fair! Who can even read text that tiny?!
A rule is a rule. If you use our product, you must honor the terms of service.
According to my rough estimation, repairs will cost 100 million DisCoins.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: 100 million?! You might as well rob us at gunpoint!

Your destruction has caused immeasurable damage to this product of Enterprise A. The hundred million is only a rough estimate, the number of critical bugs your rampage has triggered is beyond calculation.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, don't blame us for your shoddy work! If you hadn't made everything so ridiculous here, we wouldn't have had to blow the Bureau to smithereens!
In the face of Hella's accusations, the man who claimed to be from Enterprise A paced slowly, revealing his true colors.

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: No further talk is needed. What's done is done. You must take responsibility.

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: If you're currently experiencing financial difficulties, we offer an installment plan. You'll only need to pay 100,000 DisCoins per installment, with an annual interest rate of...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: (Gasps) We won’t be able to pay it off until our next life!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But sounds like the remedial classes have really paid off. You've gotten so much better at math.

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: I see you're not thrilled about the payment plan. Fortunately, we have an alternative proposition.

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: After I defeat you, you'll fix everything you broke in Project: Dark and get rid of all the bugs before you leave!
